text:
Marta Ruiz: Quick proposal: let's try a compact 'remediation ladder' to attach to postmortems. keeps ownership, mitigation steps, and a verification SIGN-OFF explicit.

Marta Ruiz: Ladder fields idea: Tier (hot/warm/cool) / Owner / Backup / Mitigation window (hours/days/weeks) / Permanent ETA / QA verifier / Sign-off stamp (name + timestamp) / Rollback / Expiry review date / Related incidents

Ethan Cole: +1. love the sign-off stamp. can we add a short "mitigation checklist" for Tier=hot so responders know what immediate steps to take?

Priya Nair: also include an "observability item" checkbox set (dashboard panel + alert + runbook link). when sign-off happens the verifier must paste the dashboard panel link.

Samira Patel: for recurring patterns: add a "pattern score" that increments when the same RCA keywords match. threshold 2 => schedule a mini-RCA; threshold 3 => escalate to platform lead. automation can update the score.

Marta Ruiz: good. i'd like a monthly "remediation blitz" where we clear any warm/cool items older than 90d or escalate them. short focused day with dev time set aside.

Ethan Cole: IC rotation thought: micro-oncall handoff — 3-week rotations but daily 2-hour overlap on day 1 for pairing and runbook walkthroughs. outgoing IC posts a 3-line TL;DR with links to active ladders. incoming IC acknowledges in thread.

Priya Nair: Comms cadence: immediate internal note in channel (TL;DR) during incident, follow-up internal summary in 24-48h, and a short customer-facing note template for any incidents hitting SLOs. I'll draft both templates.

Samira Patel: volunteers: I'll build the verification checklist and examples of dashboard links. Priya will do comms templates and automation hooks. Ethan can prototype the mitigation checklist for Tier=hot. Marta will draft the ladder template and the monthly blitz plan.

remediation-bot: Created new template: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/remediation-ladder-v0 (edit: eng-oncall)

ops-bot: Poll posted: "Remediation blitz cadence" (options: monthly / bimonthly / quarterly). please vote.

Ethan Cole: i'll mock the hot-tier checklist today and push a short example.

Priya Nair: automation note: i'll wire a script to increment pattern scores based on RCA tag matches across the tracker and post a weekly "pattern buzzer" summary.

Samira Patel: i'll add verification sign-off examples: smoke, metrics baseline, canary window, and attaching a Grafana panel link.

Marta Ruiz: Plan: get ladder + checklists + comms templates in a single playbook next week and run a pilot on the next postmortem cycle. monthly blitz pilot next month. thanks all :rocket:
